heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which devices support AR apps?
items.answer: Most recent iPhones and Android phones support ARKit and ARCore respectively.

items.question: Do you create the 3D models?
items.answer: Yes. Our artists can create or optimize 3D models for mobile AR.

items.question: Can AR be added to an existing app?
items.answer: Yes. We can add AR features to an existing iOS or Android app.

items.question: How long does augmented reality app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
